title: I Am Living an Unmarried Life With a Terminally Ill Lover
description: When a finance genius loses her ability to foresee disasters through touch, she traces its fleeting return to a bloodthirsty swordsman doomed to die. Her pragmatic solution? "I'll monetize this walking tragedy", but his adorable misery ("They sold my favorite stew!") complicates her cold calculations.
alternative_names: 시한부 연인과 동거 생활 중입니다 | 시한부 연인과 비혼 생활 중입니다
